description: The delivered arrays esm-spec §8.5 requires, computed independently of any binding: `annual` is the raw ANN_VALUE column untouched (no conversion declared -- the no-op control); `stkhgt` is STKHGT*0.3048; `stkdiam` is STKDIAM*(0.3048*1.0), the same factor reached by folding a closed Expression; `stktemp` is (STKTEMP+459.67)*0.5555555555555556, evaluated once per element with the raw value bound to the expression's single free variable. Values are shortest round-trip decimal, so every binding parses the SAME f64 bits and the comparison is byte-identity, not a tolerance.
